name: Vidit Singh Chauhan
headline: I set up and run Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring.
about: I'm a DevOps Engineer at Qpaix Infitech. I joined as an intern in January 2026 and went full-time in August. Most of my work is looking after our k3s clusters and monitoring on production servers, CI/CD pipelines for 55+ apps, and deployments for Gujarat Government projects.
I also built a 3-node k3s cluster on desktop PCs to try out GitOps with Argo CD and secrets management with Infisical.
